storyboard.ears: Nuclear power was supposed to be finished. One country is building it like crazy.
Builders started 10 new nuclear reactors last year, continuing a small but real rebound.

storyboard.ears: China alone accounts for 50 percent of all nuclear capacity now under construction.

storyboard.ears: Worldwide, nuclear power under construction equals building 78 large reactors at once.
